audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags it: Yasuo wins 53.45% over 696 games but the chart gives Urgot 6 of 7 stages. The already-audited mirror pushed rows 0 and 6 to Urgot as well, which makes it 7/7 Urgot on a lane Yasuo wins — and directly contradicts this page's own whys[6], spikes[3] and late, which all say Yasuo owns the late game.
audit.why: Flipping rows here without a ruling would either fight the mirror or ship a chart that says the loser wins every stage. Guessing costs more than skipping.
audit.corrected: Chart left untouched; question raised. All non-chart corrections still made.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text carries no cooldown numbers for the two abilities the matchup is built on.
audit.why: Disdain is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s, Fear Beyond Death 100/85/70s, Wind Wall 25s at rank 1 for 4s of uptime. Those numbers are what make "bait it then commit" actionable.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, spikes[2].text and mid rewritten with the real cooldowns and the bait-then-commit sequencing.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text calls Urgot's E "Bloodletter" — it is Disdain. The page also never states the decisive interaction: Corrosive Charge (Q), Disdain (E) and Fear Beyond Death (R) all carry the projectile flag, and Wind Wall deletes enemy projectiles for 4s.
audit.why: Fabricated ability name, and the single biggest lever in the matchup is absent. Purge (W) is correctly described as unblockable — it has no projectile flag and is short-range weapon fire.
audit.corrected: Name fixed to Disdain; Wind Wall blocking Q, E and R stated in spikes[1], spikes[2], mid and dosFull[1]; Purge's 490 range and self-slow given in dosFull[2].

edits.before: Fear Beyond Death (R) executes you below the health threshold and the leash flip can drag you back into his team — never fight him near that execute range at low HP.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death (R) is a projectile — Wind Wall eats it outright. Stay above the execute threshold, wall the cast, then run your pattern while a 100-second ultimate is off the board.

edits.before: Urgot's Bloodletter (E) knockdown plus his shield-and-legs W keep out-DPSing your pre-crit damage; his tankiness soaks your tornadoes through his first item.
edits.after: Urgot's Disdain (E, 16s) flip and his shield-and-legs W out-DPS your pre-crit damage; Wind Wall blocks the charge, but his tankiness soaks your tornadoes through item one.

edits.before: Through 4-6 he stays ahead; his E knockdown sets up his combo and his level-6 execute punishes any low-HP trade, so keep your HP topped and use Sweeping Blade only to dodge his Q, never to dive.
edits.after: Through 4-6 he stays ahead; Disdain (E, 16s) flips you into his W and the level-6 execute punishes any low-HP trade — keep HP topped, wall the flip, and use Sweeping Blade to dodge Q, never to dive.

edits.before: Dash through the wave stacking Q, tag Urgot with Q2, and only commit the EQ3 knockup when his answer is down.
edits.after: Disdain is a 16-second charge and a projectile — Wind Wall eats it, or E off a minion so it never catches you.

edits.before: Urgot wastes Disdain (Flip) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Purge is 490 range and self-slows him — step outside and he shreds air.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: One Disdain sets his whole combo; wall it or dodge it, 16s each time.
